text: 【新兴产业新设企业40万户 上半年全国经营主体发展数据发布】8月8日，市场监管总局公布数据显示，新产业新赛道企业蓄能成势，服务业新消费与高技术服务业双轮驱动，制造业转型加快，产业发展亮点纷呈。
text_en: [400,000 new enterprises in emerging industries; H1 national business entity data released] On August 8, the State Administration for Market Regulation released data showing that enterprises in new industries and new tracks are building momentum, with services sector new consumption and high-tech services acting as twin engines, manufacturing transformation accelerating, and industrial development showing multiple highlights.
